run_finetune_audio_classification: run the AudioMAE fine-tuning script for audio classification on ESC-50, Audioset, or SpeechCommands datasets
run_finetune_from_checkpoint: run fine-tuning from a pre-trained checkpoint using the --finetune flag with a checkpoint path
run_evaluation_only: run evaluation only mode on a validation dataset using the --eval flag
run_distributed_training: run distributed multi-GPU training with configurable batch size, learning rate, and gradient accumulation
run_audio_exp_with_fbank: run audio experiment using pre-computed fbank features from a specified fbank directory
